sources.title: What is a generative model? - IBM
sources.snippet: Generative AI is a type of AI that uses sophisticated models to generate new content according to an input prompt. The generative model is the computer program that employs data and algorithms to facilitate the practice of generative AI. Generative AI use cases include text summarization, text generation and image generation, as well as 3D modeling and audio creation.
